Telangana Government and Foundit Sign Pact for Youth Skilling and Jobs

The Telangana government has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Foundit, an online job portal. The agreement aims to enhance skilling and employment opportunities for the state's youth. This collaboration is expected to strengthen the job market by providing better avenues for skill development and placement.
